problemStatement.formal: For any k ≥ 1, r ≥ 1, n ≥ k, there exists N such that any r-coloring of k-element subsets of an N-element set contains a monochromatic n-element subset.
problemStatement.plain: The hypergraph Ramsey theorem: k-uniform Ramsey numbers exist for all parameters.
whyMatters: Generalizes classical graph Ramsey to arbitrary uniformity

open: Eliminate hypergraph_ramsey_exists axiom via stepping-up lemma
knownResults.goal: Prove hypergraph_ramsey_exists by well-founded induction on (k,n)
